preceding_paragraph: Table S11 | Deletion protocols on City D and Haining with the projection residual (single draw, seed 41; one noise realization; component s.d. 0.02 m). Each cell gives Top-1 partition accuracy (%) and, in parentheses, the median Euclidean distance between the retrieved template junction and the true junction in the coordinate units of the network file. Design A is 30 locations × 6 magnitudes (2, 5, 10, 20, 35 and 50 L s⁻¹) × 3 demand states; design B is 180 locations × 1 magnitude (10 L s⁻¹) × 3 demand states; both contain 540 templates. G1 queries are at 20 locations represented in both corpora and G2 queries at 20 locations represented in neither; each group contains 180 queries (3 magnitudes × 3 states per location). For G2, H0, H1 and H2 coincide because the queried location was never present. Demand states are 0.7, 1.0 and 1.2 for City D and 0.583, 0.833 and 1.0 for Haining (fractions of each model's feasible peak multiplier). Partitions (K = 15), sensors (8% of admissible junctions) and corpora were rebuilt for each network by the same pipeline. Absolute values are not comparable across networks, and no uncertainty estimate is available for these single-draw values.
